name: DC 818760 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant triple galaxy merger DC 818760, seen by Hubble.
label: deimoscosmos818760-hubble
story: Somewhere in this patch of the COSMOS field, three galaxies are merging in the early universe, a system ALMA revealed through its gas and dust. Hubble looked to map their starlight and learn how dust hides star formation in early galaxies.

claims.text: DEIMOS_COSMOS_818760 (DC 818760) is a dusty triple merger
It is a system of three closely separated sources in the COSMOS field at high redshift
DEIMOS-COSMOS-818760 is a high-redshift galaxy target of Hubble program 15692
The targets were chosen for extended dust and [CII] gas emission seen in new ALMA data
Hubble imaging aims to study the distribution of dust and dust-obscured star formation in early galaxies
